issue: Binomial dose response and LD50
initial: Binomial-logit intercept/slope, initially no explicit priors
check: Pedantic prior warnings; examine posterior response curves and derived LD50
revision: Proper coefficient priors and scientifically justified positive slope
lesson: Audit support and derived quantities; a ratio can remain poorly identified despite well-behaved coefficients
caveat: No specific posterior failure or model comparison is claimed

issue: Item difficulty and discrimination
initial: Binary logistic response versus student score
check: Stress simulations, answer-key discrepancies, implausible decreasing item response
revision: Correct keys, add guessing floor, item variation and then latent ability/discrimination
lesson: Verify the data and prediction process before explaining anomalies with extra parameters
code: Progressive Stan files; latent scale anchors
caveat: Guessing probability 1/4 depends on four possible answers

issue: Meaning of uncertain predictive differences
initial: Several small regression models; Gaussian sleep model; count models
check: Pointwise differences, influential outliers and unreliable normal approximations in small samples
revision: Exact re-LOO, robust Student-t observation model, interpret near ties cautiously
lesson: A scalar rank conceals why models differ and uncertainty in the comparison
caveat: The illustrative small-N heuristics are not universal decision thresholds

issue: Monte Carlo accuracy of quantities actually reported
initial: Properly scaled linear regression
check: R-hat, ESS, MCSE for means, quantiles and probabilities; rounding
revision: Increase sampling only for remaining Monte Carlo error after diagnosing computation
lesson: Choose simulation effort and digits from quantity-specific accuracy, not raw draw count
code: posterior summaries; MCSE for derived quantities
caveat: ESS targets do not guarantee extreme-tail accuracy or an existing mean

issue: Separate identification, scale, support and computation
initial: Deliberately flawed logistic, regression, heavy-tail and hierarchical models
check: Separation, redundant parameters, correlations, overflow, funnel divergences, chain disagreement
revision: Proper priors, remove redundancy, scale/center, enforce support, change parameterization
lesson: The same warning has competing causes; diagnose the posterior before tuning HMC
code: Pairs with divergence overlays; centered/non-centered variants
caveat: A proper Cauchy example differs from an improper flat-prior separation example

issue: Identify positive decay components
initial: One exponential with Gaussian observation error
check: Fake-data recovery and fitted curves; near-equal rates weakly identified; unconstrained regions
revision: Positive parameters, multiplicative lognormal errors when justified, ordered rates and proper priors
lesson: Predictive identification does not imply identification of each nonlinear component
caveat: No LOO demonstration; ordering removes permutation symmetry, not overlapping-component ambiguity

issue: Quality ratings with unequal evidence and rater severity
initial: Normal rating model for two movies, then many movies
check: Compare simulated balanced and unbalanced rater designs; inspect posterior uncertainty
revision: Crossed movie/rater effects, anchored means and non-centered implementation
lesson: Build dimensions and grouping one executable change at a time; account for who supplied ratings
caveat: Normal bounded ratings are an illustrative approximation rather than a universal ordinal model

issue: Reaction time trajectories with repeated subjects
initial: Gaussian regression in milliseconds
check: Prior predictive scaling, original versus log scale, shrinkage, outliers, sensitivity and LOO
revision: Varying intercepts/slopes; revise lognormal priors; robust observation model and calibrated scales
lesson: A prior belongs to a parameterization and units; carry the implied observable scale through expansions
code: brms get_prior; sample_prior only; LKJ; power sensitivity
caveat: Use corrected priors, 144 observations, baseline Days 2 mapped to zero

issue: Treatment effect on bounded repeated counts of cannabis use
initial: Gaussian and binomial models for days used out of 28
check: Impossible values and excess dispersion/extreme 0/28 outcomes; predictive checks and high Pareto-k
revision: Beta-binomial; redefine baseline as pretreatment covariate; draw treatment contrasts
lesson: Repair the observation process before interpreting effects; predictive ranking and treatment inference answer different questions
caveat: re_formula=NA sets random effects to zero; population marginal means need integration

issue: Prevalence with imperfect sensitivity and specificity
initial: Pooled binomial prevalence/test-calibration model
check: Between-study test heterogeneity and prevalence sensitivity to hyperpriors
revision: Hierarchical sensitivity/specificity, calibrated hyperpriors, MRP scaffold
lesson: Partial pooling is a scientific exchangeability assumption; sparse low-prevalence data need external calibration
caveat: Individual demographics and population cell data used for MRP are simulated

issue: Classify slopes in 1000 series under a prize/cost rule
initial: OLS slopes then a three-component slope mixture
check: Component uncertainty; expected number correct differs from probability of exceeding a threshold
revision: Posterior classification probabilities and utility-based action evaluation
lesson: Propagate uncertainty into the loss relevant to the decision, including dependence where needed
caveat: Source slope/aggregate approximations are not a general temporal dependence model

issue: Binary trial sequences and an apparent learning mechanism
initial: Logistic time trend, then history-based shock probability
check: Switch counts reveal temporal mismatch; simulate logistic data and recover apparent mechanistic coefficients
revision: Varying effects and alternative history models; leave-future-out comparisons
lesson: Rebuild simulated history recursively; predictive agreement does not establish a mechanism
caveat: Early LOO comparisons eliminate candidates before detailed PPC; final inference still requires checking

issue: Same learning example with explicit generated quantities
initial: Independent then multilevel shock/avoidance parameters
check: Chain summaries, replicated sequences, fake-data parameter recovery
revision: Priors and non-centered correlated effects; compare recovery under more trials
lesson: Validate generated quantities as part of the model and distinguish weak recovery from code failure
caveat: Potential row-wise Cholesky orientation issue recorded for source dogs_5.stan; template uses canonical orientation

issue: Adoption times with right censoring
initial: Geometric daily adoption hazard for adopted cats
check: Full observed data include censored records; fake-data fit and Kaplan-Meier curves
revision: Add correct censored likelihood, compare imputation/alternative formulations, consider individual variation
lesson: Implement the observation process before inferring duration or heterogeneity
code: Event mass versus survival; known-data tests
caveat: Continuous imputation demonstration should not be transplanted blindly to discrete event times

issue: Goal differences and equivalent probability formulations
initial: Signed-square-root transformed goal difference
check: Back-transformation PPC exposes a factor-of-two implementation bug
revision: Fix transformation; compare natural/discretized and bivariate goal models
lesson: A fit can diagnose a coding bug; compare densities/masses only on a common predictive target
caveat: Likelihood aggregation and scoring dimension must match the outcome being compared

issue: Overdispersed apartment counts with exposure
initial: Poisson regression with log exposure offset
check: PPC dispersion, zero reliability, high k, and overly optimistic observation-specific latent fits
revision: Negative binomial, zero inflation when supported, moment matching, K-fold, integrate held-out latent effect
lesson: High k can expose both unstable importance sampling and substantive misspecification
code: Chain-aware PSIS; marginal latent log likelihood
caveat: Errata corrects zero fraction to 36%; repaired PSIS is not a repaired model

issue: Putting success over distance with physical structure
initial: Logistic then angle-error mechanistic binomial
check: Long-distance misfit, sampling variance too small for huge trial counts, residual shape and LOO
revision: Distance-control component, discrepancy models, revise latent error scale; compare local predictions
lesson: Expand for a named failure; added mechanistic parameters can be weakly identified despite predictive success
caveat: Bounded exponential latent-prior normalization/hyperprior issue is listed as an unresolved source interpretation

issue: Hidden behavioral states of movement tracks
initial: HMM gamma step length with point mass at zero and von Mises angle
check: State probabilities, simulated tracks, pseudo-residuals and autocorrelation
revision: Transition covariates, track resets and shark-level effects
lesson: Marginalize discrete states; decoding is uncertain inference, not observed state truth
caveat: Data README is incomplete; regular time intervals and sentinel handling require explicit verification

issue: Daily births: long trend, annual, weekly and calendar effects
initial: Long-scale GP, then periodic/weekday components
check: Residual patterns, redundant GP constant/intercept, slow NCP and treedepth; prior sensitivity
revision: Drop redundancy; add justified components; stronger information can favor centered seasonal effects
lesson: Decompose a residual feature at a time; computation and interpretable decomposition must both survive revision
code: HSGP basis expansion; sparse day effects; conditional component plots
caveat: Short Pathfinder/provisional fits are not final validated posterior evidence

issue: Predict grades with correlated predictors
initial: Wide independent coefficients in a many-predictor regression
check: Prior R-squared near one; posterior versus LOO R-squared and coefficient instability
revision: Scale total signal, regularized horseshoe/R2D2; projection from a checked reference with validated search
lesson: Regularize the joint predictor before selecting; predictive reduction is separate from causal adjustment
caveat: R2D2 residual scale prior is half-Student-t(3), per errata

issue: Crossed binary person/item effects
initial: Non-centered logistic crossed effects
check: Slow sampling, low ESS and high R-hat without divergences; correlated redundant intercept structure
revision: Sum-to-zero identification; centered effects where strongly informed; centered predictors; adequate warmup
lesson: No divergences does not imply good geometry; centered versus non-centered is data dependent
caveat: Constraints can change the meaning of the intercept/prior; normal variants are auxiliary

issue: Orbit ODE and disconnected solutions
initial: Full seven-parameter orbit model
check: Long chain runtimes, chain-specific trajectories and 1D density grid after simplification
revision: Fix components to diagnose, investigate mode plausibility, use multipath Pathfinder initialization and justified priors
lesson: Simplify to distinguish numerical cost, poor starts and substantive modes; do not silently discard chains
code: ODE slices; prediction by chain; informed initialization
caveat: 1D conditional slices and chain stacking are not generic evidence for global posterior mode weights

issue: Validate a Poisson mixture with logistic mixing weights
initial: Implement logistic and mixture parts separately
check: Rank checks, contraction and data-dependent quantities expose whole-dataset mixing, unused parameter and double prior
revision: Pointwise log_mix; consistent ordered simulator; repair redundant priors; staged SBC
lesson: Calibration and learning are distinct; a procedure returning its prior can pass marginal ranks
code: SBC generator/backend; derived ranks; failure ledger
caveat: Errata reverses Fano rejection inequality; conditional calibration must report restricted domain and failed fits
